# PROCESS — cand_0004 (parent cand_0003, the current champion)

Focus this iteration: RECOVER the regressions cand_0003 introduced vs cand_0001
({254-34, 267-18, 45300, 50682, 56561}), plus one never-solved task, WITHOUT losing
cand_0003's accepted gains ({31420, 347-49, 42930, 47699, 50631, 55224}). All edits are
in `prompt.md`; `task_template.md` untouched (placeholders intact).

## Decisive scorer fact discovered this iteration (grounds EDIT 1)
`third_party/spreadsheetbench/evaluation/evaluation.py` → `cell_level_compare` compares
**only cell VALUES**: the `compare_fill_color` and `compare_font_color` calls are
**commented out**. Colors, fills, fonts, borders, number formats are NEVER graded. This is
hidden knowledge the agent cannot derive and it explains a whole failure mode: agents that
"highlight/format" cells but never write the required VALUE score 0.

## Diagnosis (fan-out: 3 read-only subagents over the failing + regressed traces, cross-checked vs the cand_0001 passing rollouts in run_suite/rollouts/val)
Regressions were compared cand_0001 (PASS) vs cand_0003 (FAIL) directly.

| task | was | now | root cause | verdict |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 254-34 | pass (0001) | fail (0003) | Instruction says "highlight cells that sum to ~994110"; graded cell `Before!C2` expects the SUM value. 0001 computed subset-sum → wrote 994110 to C2. 0003 copied the "After" sheet's FILLS (ungraded) and left C2 empty → 0. cand_0003's "answer is already in the workbook, base on it" pushed the wholesale-copy. | PROMPT-CAUSED → EDIT 1 |
| 56561 | pass (0001) | fail 1/3 (0003) | Fill G5:G12 with last cumulative-units per stock. 0001 wrote a robust non-spilling `=IF(...LOOKUP(2,1/(...),...))` reference formula → 3/3. 0003 saw "FILTER/arrayformula" in the instruction, invoked the dynamic-array caveat, and HARDCODED literals from a reconstructed buy/sell model → over-fit visible variant, failed 2 hidden. | PROMPT-CAUSED → EDIT 2 |
| 50682 | pass (0001) | fail (0003) | Sum qty of part A2 across columns O→end. 0001 did a uniform `SUMPRODUCT((O..last-1=$A2)*qty)` sweep → 3/3. 0003 invented header-based column pairing + MOD parity (structure that only fit the sample) → wrong on all 3. cand_0003's "inspect ALL columns … replicate exact first-vs-last" invited the over-engineering. | PROMPT-CAUSED → EDIT 3 |
| 157-4 | never solved | fail | Delete rows where all data cells empty. Agent tested cols F:M, but M="Weeknumber" is auto-filled 1,2,3… so "all empty" is never true → deleted nothing → output=input. Correct range F:L (the user's own VBA). | NEVER-SOLVED, actionable → EDIT 4 |
| 267-18 | pass (0001) | fail (0003) | `//`-prefix on a CONCATENATE for yellow rows. 0001 prefixed the whole result `="//"&(formula)`; 0003 injected `//` mid-formula before the URL. Pure placement/interpretation. | VARIANCE — no reliable prompt fix. NOT touched. |
| 45300 | pass (0001) | fail (0003) | "remove everything from first 'FT'". 0001 `text[:idx]`; 0003 added an unrequested `.rstrip()` that strips a trailing space the GT keeps. | VARIANCE (embellishment); the only safe rule for it is the "no-embellishment" block that SANK cand_0002 — deliberately NOT re-added. |

Never-solved tasks with no safe general prose fix (skipped, documented): 398-14 (aggregate
"keys repeated across sheets" + empty→hyphen), 413-15 (NET/TOTAL value logic), 577-40
(exact blank/zero deletion criterion), 269-44 (GT uses a non-obvious reading; every
candidate converges on the defensible answer and is rejected), 146-49 (cand_0001 = infra
BadRequest noise; others = hard exact-set string algorithm), 250-20 case-2 (data-type/
ordering edge in one hidden case; even full-region readers fail it), 34-5 (wrong "current
month" reference date — no anchor in the instruction to calibrate the frozen GT date).

## Ranked kept edits (leverage = # tasks × trials × recoverable)
| # | file | lever (SKILL type) | edit | tag |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | prompt.md (new "THE GRADER READS ONLY CELL VALUES" block) | KNOWLEDGE (add a rule grounded in scorer source) | fills/fonts/formats are never graded; a highlight/format task still needs the VALUE; single empty answer cell for a find/highlight task wants the RESULT (sum/count/label); pure-highlight over data → leave values intact | CONTRACT/KNOWLEDGE |
| 2 | prompt.md (PRODUCE-THE-RESULT block) | NARROW an existing rule | dynamic-array caveat is about the formula YOU write, not words in the task; prefer a NON-spilling reference formula (LOOKUP/INDEX-MATCH/SUMPRODUCT/SUMIFS) over hardcoded literals; literals only when a spill is genuinely required | KNOWLEDGE (narrowing) |
| 3 | prompt.md (WRITE-GENERAL-CODE workbook-reuse bullet) | SOFTEN over-engineering (SKILL: over-doing → cut/soften) | reuse EXISTING method still stands, but do NOT invent structural assumptions (column pairing/parity, fixed group sizes, row counts, block boundaries); prefer a uniform full-region scan when it already yields the answer | CONFLICT/consolidation (narrowing) |
| 4 | prompt.md (scope/no-op-red-flag bullet) | ADD narrowing knowledge | for "all cells empty" delete/filter tests, exclude auto-filled index/serial/counter columns that are never blank | KNOWLEDGE (additive) |

## VERIFY-THE-FIX + blast radius (per edit)
- EDIT 1: trace 254-34 cand_0003 copied After fills, `VERIFY … Before!C2 value: None` → 0; cand_0001 wrote `ws_answer['C2']=int(994110)` → 3/3. Rule makes the agent write the VALUE (the sum) into the single empty answer cell. BOUNDED/additive: passing tasks pass because their VALUES are right; telling the agent fills are ignored cannot make it corrupt values. No passing task relies on the agent believing fills are graded.
- EDIT 2: trace 56561 cand_0003 wrote `ws.cell(r,prev_col).value = computed_prev_by_row.get(r,0)` (literals) after seeing "arrayformula"; cand_0001 wrote the `LOOKUP(2,1/(...))` formula. Rule steers back to the reference formula. BOUNDED: cand_0003's caveat-fixes 50526 (FILTER) and 50631 (array WORKDAY) genuinely require spilling with no single-cell equivalent, so the retained "fall back to literals when a spill is genuinely required" still routes them to literals — both stay passing.
- EDIT 3: trace 50682 cand_0003 built `pair_start_cols` via header-present/next-absent + MOD-parity; cand_0001 used a uniform SUMPRODUCT sweep. Rule discourages the invented structure. BOUNDED/additive: the "reuse an EXISTING method" clause is kept (42930 reuses a real subdivision→number lookup TABLE, which is existing structure, not invented — unaffected); the caution only fires on structure the sample "merely happens to satisfy".
- EDIT 4: trace 157-4 tested F:M incl. always-filled "Weeknumber" → `deleted_rows=[]` → no-op; correct range F:L. Rule tells the agent to exclude serial/counter columns from emptiness tests. BOUNDED/additive: conditional on "delete by all-empty test"; a passing deletion task testing real data columns is unaffected.

## Deliberately NOT re-tried (would repeat a refuted regression)
- cand_0002's "no-embellishment / leave #N/A / don't-fill-blank" global block (broke {254-34,267-18,56561,567-21}) — the only rule that would target 45300's `.rstrip()`, but its blast radius sank cand_0002. Left out; 45300 accepted as variance.
- cand_0002's step-3 VERIFY rewrite and "blue column → inspect fills" bullet — both refuted. Not re-added.
- No global decision/permission rule was loosened. Nothing in cand_0001/cand_0003 `broke` sets was re-introduced as a new edit.

## Process & features used
- 3 parallel read-only diagnosis subagents (format-cluster A, format-cluster B, computation
  regressions), each comparing cand_0003-FAIL vs cand_0001-PASS rollouts and attributing each
  failure to PROMPT-CAUSED (fixable) vs VARIANCE/INFRA (skip). Scorer fact verified directly
  against evaluation.py before shipping EDIT 1. Edits applied serially in this one candidate.
